spans.s:
Relative or third personal pronoun, (सः सा तद्)
He, she, it, that man, that woman, that thing.
E.
तन to extend or spread, Uṇādi affix अदि.

(इ) तदि r. 1st cl. (तन्दते)
To be content or happy.

ind.
Then, at that time.
E.
तद् that, दाच affix, implying time.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Transgressing, going beyond the bounds.

n. adv. (-रं)
Next, afterwards.
E.
तत् that, अनन्तर after.

n. adv. (-न्तं)
To that end, just so far.
E.
तद, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 On that account, with that object.
2 Having such a meaning.
E.
तद्, and अर्थ sense.

n. (-णं)
1 A thing returned.
2 Delivering any article.
E.
तद, and अर्पण delivery.

n. (-त्वं)
Time being, time present.
E.
तदा then, त्व affix of the abstract.

ind.
Then, at that time.
E.
तद that, दानीम् aff.

ind.
Thenceforward.
E.
तदा, and प्रभृति the rest.

n. (-खं)
Commencement, beginning.
E.
तदा, and मुख beginning.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
That, that person, that thing.
E.
तद्, and छ aff.

ind.
1 In the course of the day.
2 Day by day.
n. (-नं)
On a certain day.
E.
तद् that, and दिन a day.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Miserly, niggardly.
E.
तत् thence, धन wealth.

ind.
So, in like manner, the correlative to यद्वत् as.
E.
तद् that, वति aff.

f. (-ला)
A sort of arrow.
E.
तत् thence, वल strong.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
In that manner, in such a manner, of such a kind or sort.
E.
तद्, and विध way.

m. (-तः)
A derivative noun, as a patronymic or attributive of various kinds, &c.
n. (-तं)
The formation of such nouns.
E.
तत् that, (original noun,) हित what relates to or suits.

n. (-र्थ्यं)
1 Sameness or precision of meaning.
2 Identity of object.
E.
तदर्थ, यञ् aff.

n. (-त्म्यं)
Identity, unity, sameness.
E.
तदात्म same, and यञ् aff.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Such like, like him or it, &c.
E.
तद् that, दृश to see, affix क्विन्; also with कञ् affix तादृश. mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) or with क्म affix, तादृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं).
